data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 were GBP 396.75m. Using the gross claims development table the syndicate shows a small gross prior-year strengthening of GBP 1.95m (c.0.49% of opening reserves) driven by development on older underwriting years (2013-2016). The managing agent narrative, however, reports prior year net reserve releases of GBP 8.5m, primarily in Treaty Property catastrophe business in relation to the 'HIM' losses; this net figure reflects reinsurance recoveries and explains the apparent discrepancy between the gross triangle (small strengthening) and the net narrative (release).

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development chosen from the gross claims development table (claims triangle) on page 39. The managing agent text on the movement (note 4) reports a net prior-year release of GBP 8.5m (net of reinsurance) primarily in Treaty Property CAT relating to 'HIM losses' - this is a NET figure and differs from the gross triangle result (small gross strengthening of GBP 1.949m). The triangle and movement note are consistent in identifying Treaty/Property catastrophe activity but differ in sign/magnitude after reinsurance. 'HIM losses' is mentioned but not defined or dated. All monetary figures extracted from tables presented in GBP 000 and converted to millions; triangle units are thousands (GBP 000).
